text: The lab results show predominantly unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia with normal liver enzymes, which is reassuring against biliary atresia or hepatitis. speaker: Doctor
text: With galactosemia and biliary atresia ruled out by normal labs and tests, this presentation is classic for breast milk jaundice. I will now request images to confirm the clinical appearance of the jaundice before finalizing the diagnosis. REQUEST IMAGES
